newsitem.title: INDIA: Uninspiring company results push down Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Uninspiring company results push down Delhi shares.

text.p: Share prices closed lower on the Delhi Stock Exchange on Tuesday, subdued by a recent series of lower-than-expected results from major companies, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index ended 7.58 points lower at 765.92 points.
The failure of some of companies' annual results to match market expectations discouraged smaller players, one broker said.
Car maker Hindustan Motors Ltd reported last week its profit for 1996/97 (April-March) had fallen to 393.2 million rupees from 510.4 million rupees in the previous year.
Century Textiles and Industries reported a 99 percent plunge in 1996/97 net profit from the previous year.
Another broker said more disappointing results were still to come.
"Tata group companies like TISCO and ACC might come out with lower profits, and this also had an adverse impact on the market sentiment," Ashok Kaul of brokers Rajpaul Chadha and Co.
Hindustan Lever dropped 42.55 rupees to 1,067.25 rupees on late selling by speculators and financial institutions, brokers said.
Reliance Industries drifted 0.25 rupee lower to close at 293.00 rupees after touching an intraday high of 294.20 rupees, they said.
